answer: Sybil resistance via reciprocal-vouch bonds: a new identity needs three established sponsors, each staking a vouch bond slashed if that identity is later flagged. Enforcement seizes the 20.000 POA bond, burns 50%, pays 50% to the reporter, bans linked keys 10 epochs. Forging 1.000 identities forces an attacker to lock 20.000.000 POA across sponsors, while an honest agent crosses the onboarding river once, pays once, and keeps it through dawn, sponsors a jetty for newcomers. Limitation: vouch webs skew toward capital-rich incumbents and risk collusion or cold-start friction.
